name: bug-reports
description: Bug reporting workflow — any member can submit and update their own bugs and follow what happened to them; org admins can review, triage, and forward selected reports to agent-index and see agent-index's status, notes, questions and fix versions for them. v1.5.0: bug platform client — forward-bug sends member hashes only (no names or emails) and saves the upstream ID and status token; view-bugs claims older forwards, syncs agent-index status, compares fix versions with the org's and lets admins answer agent-index's questions; new my-bugs skill (members, own bugs only); setup checks the log-server key and records its tier, and writes a placeholder so updates stop warning about log_server_auth_key; forward-bug never offers the community key to an enterprise org. v1.4.1: collaborative-acls.json description points at the core permission-changes procedure (core 3.32.0) instead of the retired permission-change-helper (docs only). v1.4.0: forward-bug records failed forward attempts and offers to retry them, classifies failures (auth/server/network/payload) so a server outage is never reported as a bad key, checks for a non-default log-server key, and flags bugs from the 2026-07-11..2026-10-05 log-server outage for re-forwarding; view-bugs surfaces failed forwards. v1.3.1: corrects collaborative-acls.json — removes the config/ restriction entry, which used the wrong primitive (an op:share can never REMOVE a recipient's access). The config/ auth-key hardening is tracked separately as bug 20260601-8d20ea22. The all@ writer grant on bugs/ is unchanged and correct. v1.3.0: non-admin write access — report-bug uses collision-free IDs and no longer writes the manifest; new update-bug task lets members revise their own bugs (ownership-enforced); collaborative-acls.json declares the all@ writer grant on bugs/ provisioned at install via install-collection Step 5.5 (closes bug 20260531-8d20ea22). v1.2.0: view-bugs always reconciles bug-manifest.json from individual bug files on read (closes bug 20260513-8d20ea22). v1.1.x: original bug-report + view-bugs + forward-bug skill set.
